in.other_title: Stabilised expert iteration improves worst-case performance; debate does particularly well
in.rationale: McAleese et al. suggest a single critique step may be weaker than multi-step procedures such as consultancy or debate. Hammond and Adam-Day compare protocols on APPS code validation and report stabilised expert iteration improves every protocol's worst-case performance with debate performing particularly well; verifiers are GPT-4o-mini models, not human contractors, and code snippets are APPS solutions.
in.scope: proposed ADDRESSES: whether multi-step interactive protocols such as debate help verify code beyond a single critique, for APPS code validation

text: The authors list further limitations: evaluated code snippets are short with no multi-file or repository support, the absolute rate of nitpicks and hallucinated bugs remains quite high, complex bugs spread across many lines were not investigated, and a single step of critique may be substantially weaker than multi-step interactive procedures such as consultancy or debate.
title: Short snippets, high hallucination rate; single critique may be weaker than debate
